notes: The Spotify Client ID is baked in. Spotify has frozen new registrations, so asking for one nobody can obtain made the Spotify half unusable; the field now comes pre-filled and a sign-in works out of the box. It is a fallback, never an override — paste your own id in and that one wins. It is not registered to this app, so the consent screen names another application and the requests count against its quota; the README appendix and the page both say so.
